actions.name: Toggle Heater
actions.description: Turns the internal heater on or off.
actions.aiHints: Use this if the temperature is getting too low or if frost is detected.

variables.name: Temperature
variables.aiGuidance: Monitor this to determine if the heater should be toggled.

variables.name: Heater Status
variables.description: Whether the internal heater is currently running.

events.name: Frost Warning
events.description: Fired when the temperature drops below freezing.
events.aiHints: You should probably turn on the heater if you receive this event.
